card.no_entity: Choose the sensor that measures the grain in the card editor.
card.not_a_length: {entity} isn’t a length ({unit}). Choose a distance or level sensor.
card.no_dimensions: Enter the silo’s diameter and ring height in the card editor.

editor.measure_distance: The distance down to the grain (sensor at the top)
editor.sensor_height_helper: Above the silo’s lowest point. Leave empty when the sensor is at the very top.
editor.rings_helper: The straight wall, from the eave down to the hopper or floor. A wall without rings is 1 ring as tall as the wall.
editor.top_opening_helper: The flat lid at the top of the roof. 0 when the roof comes to a point.
editor.outlet_helper: 0 when the hopper comes to a point.
editor.density_helper: Leave empty to use the grain’s standard bushel weight ({value}).
editor.density_helper_none: Choose a grain, or enter a density or a capacity, to see the weight.
editor.capacity_helper: From the manufacturer. Replaces the density.
editor.include_roof: Full means filled to the peak
editor.include_roof_helper: Otherwise full is at the eave, and grain in the roof shows above 100 %.
editor.low_level_helper: Under this, the grain is drawn in the warning colour. 0 turns it off.
editor.title: Title
editor.title_helper: Leave empty for the device’s name.
editor.title_position_header: In the header, with the icon
editor.show_last_reading_helper: While the sensor has no reading, show its last one from the history, greyed.
editor.stale_after_helper: Shows the sensor as unavailable when its last reading is older than this. Empty: off. With ESPHome, give the sensor force_update: true.
editor.from_integration: This sensor comes from the Silo integration: the silo’s shape and contents are set there, once.
editor.capacity_per_ring: One full ring (the hopper and roof follow from their volume)
editor.tiles_hint: Drag the handle to reorder. The switch shows or hides a tile.
editor.primary_helper: The big number at the top. When it can’t be shown (no weight without a grain, density or capacity), the fill is shown instead.
editor.unit_helper: Each length below can have a unit of its own; this one is for the rest.
